description: Alethic's dependency updates: Renovate on our Forgejo since 2026-11-15, when Alethic's canonical repository moved there (GitHub is its mirror, where v* tags publish to PyPI). Estate defaults come from the preset emiluzelac/renovate-config. Everything waits for review: pyproject.toml's ranges are what every installer of alethic-kernel resolves, so they move on purpose, never by themselves.
